label: Token-2022 coverage from recorded LOCATE runs. An extension is exercised only when a recorded case used it.

exercised.evidence: proof/local-validator/suite.json case 12-transfer-fee-net passed, and case 13-changed-fee refused return with 6013. Fork OpenAI lifecycle delivered 1998473 raw from a 2018660 loan at 100 bps.
Local validator case 14-pause refused take with 6007. Case 15-resume-after-pause passed after resume.
Local validator case 18-memo-requirement passed with takeOk true after the memo-transfer requirement was enabled.

refusedOrWeak.evidence: Local validator case 16-freeze expected a frozen lender account to refuse take. The take failed with 6010, which is TakeRefusedUnfunded. That code is also used for missing and insufficient delegation, so this case does not isolate a freeze error.
